content: Tailwind CSS v4 (released Jan 2025) uses CSS-first configuration via @theme directive instead of tailwind.config.js. All design tokens are exposed as CSS custom properties. Custom fonts: --font-mono in @theme generates font-mono utility. Colors: --color-* namespace generates bg-*, text-*, border-* utilities. No content paths needed (auto-detection). Current stable: v4.3.3 (Jul 2026).
